provenance.external_hash_comparison: Not available; no expected SHA-256 was supplied.

timestamp_audit.timezone: UTC interpretation of epoch seconds; the integer field itself carries no explicit offset
timestamp_audit.timestamp_quality: All rows parsed and are non-decreasing; duplicate timestamps are expected because many events share a second.

labels.interpretation: Ground-truth event records contain attack names only; no BENIGN/normal value is present. Attack count means all rows are attack-event records, not that this file is a complete labeled traffic dataset.

temporal_feasibility.next_window_feasibility: Not feasible for the locked binary BENIGN/ATTACK forecast using this file alone because every observed window is an attack-event window.

risks: type is the attack-event ground-truth label and must never be a historical feature.
src_ip and dst_ip may encode the attack environment or event identity; the file contains only 14 source IPs and 146 destination IPs.
Fixed time periods and event timestamps may identify attack activity.
This ground-truth file has no filename-independent scenario identifier, but IP/time combinations can act as proxies.
The file must not be used alone to construct benign historical states or traffic features.

decision_text: TIMESTAMP EXISTS BUT MORE DATA REQUIRED
decision_reason: The file has genuine, ordered timestamps and attack categories, but it is attack-only ground truth with no benign observations and no traffic-flow statistics. A separate official processed network traffic CSV containing benign and attack flows, timestamps, and usable flow features is required.
required_additional_file: One official TON_IoT processed network traffic CSV with ts (or equivalent timestamp), benign/attack label, and network flow features; exact filename and size are not inferred here.
